title: Source-guided regional anatomy
sourceAttribution: Brunet et al. / ESRF Human Organ Atlas
registration: Endpoints match original s4 voxel centers [0,0,0] and [474,474,529]. Sample nearest at round(sourceNormalizedXYZ*(dimensions-1)).
rendering: Labels tint independently measured tissue density; labels must never be rendered as filled chamber contents.
method: Source-guided LV and tricuspid geometry, connected measured arterial-wall cores, an independently reviewed pulmonary hinge and RV outflow corridor, followed by constrained tissue-geodesic propagation. Edge watershed and unconstrained geodesic alternatives were compared and rejected where they retained incorrect wall identities. Image intensities and rendering geometry are unchanged.
septalDisplayConvention: The continuous compact interventricular myocardium is assigned to the LV myocardial body. RV free wall and its nonseptal trabeculated structures remain RV. The septum is shared anatomy; this color convention is not a separate septal segmentation.
validation: Twelve independent pre-candidate chamber/arterial control points, five separately recorded source-reviewed aortic/RVOT error points, and twenty existing v4 boundary regression points pass. Multiplanar source/overlay comparisons were reviewed. These are targeted diagnostic checks, not global segmentation accuracy, expert ground truth, a Dice score or clinical validation.
limitations: Approximate regional annotations; no expert reference segmentation or trained segmentation model.
The compact interventricular septum is displayed with the LV myocardial body as a regional convention.
Pulmonary hinge and LV/atrial{local-home} transitions are visually estimated. Shared fibrous tissue, valve attachment zones and small vessels remain uncertain.
Arterial-wall intensity is used only with spatial and continuity constraints; it does not independently establish tissue identity.
Valves, coronary vessels, individual pulmonary veins, caval veins and appendages are not separately segmented.
No fiber tractography, deformation, slice realignment or synthetic anatomical reconstruction is performed.
These labels are not for quantitative chamber volume, wall thickness, procedural or diagnostic measurements.

sourceReferences.title: Brunet et al., 2023 preprint, Figures 3 and 5

labels.name: Unclassified tissue
labels.description: Tissue outside the six regional annotations remains neutral. Coronary, cardiac venous, individual pulmonary-vein and caval identities are not separately inferred.

labels.name: Left ventricle
labels.description: Continuous LV myocardial body, including compact septal myocardium under the stated display convention. Source-guided contours are retained; a local arterial-shell correction prevents aortic root wall from being mistaken for compact LV muscle.
labels.method: Source-guided anatomy and arterial-wall continuity with constrained tissue-geodesic refinement.

labels.name: Right ventricle
labels.description: RV free wall, nonseptal trabeculated structures and muscular outflow. The ventricular side of the pulmonary hinge is explicitly connected to the RV, preventing a tricuspid-divider rule from recoloring the RV outflow as atrium or artery.
labels.method: Source-guided anatomy and arterial-wall continuity with constrained tissue-geodesic refinement.

labels.name: Left atrium
labels.description: Collapsed LA territory refined along connected measured tissue. Mitral, appendage and individual pulmonary-vein transitions remain provisional.
labels.method: Source-guided anatomy and arterial-wall continuity with constrained tissue-geodesic refinement.

labels.name: Right atrium
labels.description: RA wall and pectinate territory extending to the reviewed curved tricuspid junction. The muscular RV outflow is excluded from this atrial division.
labels.method: Source-guided anatomy and arterial-wall continuity with constrained tissue-geodesic refinement.

labels.name: Aortic outflow
labels.description: Connected aortic arterial wall and proximal root, using its measured intensity, source location and continuity. Color extension into adjacent LV muscle and the atrial/mitral junction is constrained; exact annular boundaries remain approximate.
labels.method: Source-guided anatomy and arterial-wall continuity with constrained tissue-geodesic refinement.

labels.name: Pulmonary outflow
labels.description: Pulmonary arterial wall and root proximal to a source-reviewed, oblique pulmonary hinge. The muscular RV outflow below that transition retains ventricular identity; distal branches are not separately identified.
labels.method: Source-guided anatomy and arterial-wall continuity with constrained tissue-geodesic refinement.
